name: auto-map-studio
description: Codex-native AI tileset, design-first 2D map, interior, and tactical battle-map workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Generate, clean, align, preview, and export 2D map assets in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Auto Map Studio provides a Codex-native workflow for 2D game maps: plan tilemap or layered-map pipelines, prompt image generation for full-map concepts and rough map assets, detect and clean AI-generated tiles, normalize them into grid-perfect PNG tilesets, export metadata, and create design-first map previews with Tiled-style object data.
capabilities: Tiled JSON and object layer export
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Auto Map Studio to generate or clean a 2D RPG tileset and map preview.
